checks: Projection of the hull is [−1,1], leaving exactly three integer sites. At the extreme bases only that base's generators contribute. At zero the two endpoint coefficients agree, so the endpoint contribution is a multiple of their midpoint body. Interval addition and convexity of K give the midpoint body [−5/4,5/4]×K contained in the prescribed middle fiber, establishing exactness. The three volumes are 4,4,1 and no site is half-heavy.

At the centroid of a full actual fiber the triangle coordinate is g. Each barycentric coordinate equals 1/3 there, so a halfspace with one such coordinate at least 1/3 captures precisely a ratio (2/3)^2=4/9 of the triangle's area. Acting only on that coordinate gives the upper bound 4a/9 for any own capacity at this mark and therefore the single-node bound 16/9.

A full binary tree with at most three distinct node labels has either one or three nodes. The sole pair of distinct bases with an integral midpoint is −1 and 1, with midpoint zero. Their full-fiber centroids have interval coordinate zero, so their average does too. The actual middle cut x≤0 has volume 5/4. Combining with the smaller endpoint's upper bound 4/9 gives 61/36. The actual middle centroid instead has interval coordinate 3/4.

Independently computed all interval endpoints, midpoints, volumes and exact rational comparisons. Both 16/9 and 61/36 are below 243/128=9(3/4)^3/2. Source 6db3f4932a57c2cc explicitly uses centroids of the three full actual fibers and leaves different mark selections outside its claim.

issues.defect: The exact theorem statement does not specify whose centroids the leaves carry. The neighboring binary certificate permits leaf subbodies D_z⊆C_z. Under that reading take the left leaf subbody [1,2]×K with mark (3/2,g), and the full right leaf [−1/2,1/2]×K with mark (0,g). The parent mark is (3/4,g), the centroid of the full middle fiber. Accepted 6769574fc1bd9f8d gives actual own capacity at least 27/16 in the middle and at least 27/64 at each leaf (on the left already in its subbody). The permitted actual-fiber version of the rule can thus use value at least 135/64>61/36. The proof's x≤0 middle cut contains only the averaged full-fiber centroid, not this alternative root mark.
